title: fix(fields): permission-ref / position-ref cells draw the registry label, the name on title

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：用户详情页的「权限集」「岗位」两个页签，列表单元格从显示 API 名（如 `organization_admin_no_bypass`）改为显示目录里的标签（如 "Organization Admin"），鼠标悬停显示 API 名；目录里查不到的名字照原样显示。
- 为什么改：管理员看不出一个用户到底持有哪些权限集，只能逐个点开；编辑表单早已显示标签，只读单元格没有。
- 风险与回滚：只改只读显示，不改存储与写入；目录读取失败或未返回时退回显示 API 名。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefCell.tsx`（新的只读单元格）、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/registryCatalog.ts`（共享目录读取，每个数据源每种类型只请求一次）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`（把字段的 `widget` 传给单元格类型解析的一行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.registryRefColumn.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿；或在 showcase 里打开 Setup → Users → 任一用户 → Permission Sets，应看到权限集标签，悬停看到 API 名。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` and `sys_user_position.position` are by-name text columns declaring `widget: 'permission-ref'` / `widget: 'position-ref'`. The edit face (`RegistryRefField` in `@object-ui/fields`, not the form renderer the card names) already listed the registry with labels; no read cell did, so a user's Permission Sets and Positions tabs printed the api name.

- **A read face in `@object-ui/fields`** (`widgets/RegistryRefCell.tsx`), registered under `permission-ref` / `position-ref`, which `resolveCellRendererType` now promotes a textual field declaring either widget to (`WIDGET_CELL_RENDERER_TYPES`, beside `object-ref` / `recipient-picker`). It draws the registry label with the stored name on `title`.
- **One read for the whole list** (`widgets/registryCatalog.ts`): the catalog the edit picker lists, `DataSource.listMetadataItems(type)` (`GET /api/v1/meta/:type`), read once per data source and registry type and shared by every cell; a cell mounting after it settled draws the label on its first render. A failed read is not kept, so the next cell asks again. No new endpoint. `RegistryRefField` now imports its `registryLister` narrowing from that module instead of keeping its own copy; its behaviour is unchanged.
- **The fallback**: a name the catalog does not hold, or holds without a label, draws as the name (same face as the text cell); so does every cell while the catalog loads, when it fails, or when no data source can list a registry.
- **The related list reaches it**: `RelatedList`'s `makeCell` resolved the cell key from `type` and `format` only, so the declared `widget` never reached the cell resolution there (the grid already passed it). It now passes `widget` too. Side effect named: a related-list column declaring `object-ref` also reaches its console face now; `recipient-picker` still draws its stored text there, because the related list passes no `dependentValues`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/RegistryRefCell.readFace.test.tsx` — the widget picks the key; `permission-ref` and `position-ref` each draw the label with the name on `title` from ONE `listMetadataItems` call shared by several cells; a late mount draws the label at once with no second read; **the fallback** (an unknown name and an unlabelled one render the name); no data source, loading and a failed catalog draw the name, and a failed catalog is re-read; an empty value draws the shared No-value glyph and reads nothing.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.registryRefColumn.test.tsx` — the real `RelatedList` and data-table, one test per acceptance box: Permission Sets (label, api name on `title`, one catalog read for the column), Positions, and an unknown name rendering as the name.
- Census pins updated for the two new registered keys: `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596.test.tsx` (fields) and `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464.test.tsx` (plugin-detail, fit side 38 → 40).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's mechanism names `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` as the edit face; the picker is `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx` (form.tsx only lists the widget names it hands a data source). The catalog reused is that picker's.
- The `object-ref` / `recipient-picker` faces live in `@object-ui/app-shell`, kept out of `@object-ui/fields` for the console's eager `ui-components` chunk; this card's ruling puts the registry-name face in `@object-ui/fields`. Its reader is the picker's own catalog call plus a small cache. CI's `check:eager-closure` step weighs it; this branch did not build the console locally.
- Labels are whatever `GET /meta/:type` serves; the server already translates the security catalog's labels for that route, so the cell does no client translation.
- The edit picker (`RegistryRefField`) still reads its catalog fresh per mount, uncached: a set authored in Studio is listed on the next form, as before.
